summary_markdown: The conversation focused on migrating staging analytics demographics to the production environment for a client meeting scheduled the next day. Initially, [p1] reported that the data was missing in production despite being available in staging. After initial attempts by [me] to push the data and refresh the cache, the issue persisted. Later, [me] confirmed that after restarting production (without downtime), no data appeared, and the server returned empty results. The root cause was identified as a dependency on an exclusive lock on `agg_5`. [me] implemented a fix which successfully resolved the data display issue.
decisions: The analytics demographics were migrated from staging to production.
